description: The bottom dock starts with its default floating gap, moves flush to the screen edge during capture, and then floats again.

assertions.comment: At startup, I see the default floating dock use a 108px-high surface.
At startup, I see the floating panel begin at y=36 in its 108px-high surface.
At startup, I see the 64px panel end at y=100, leaving the default 8px floating gap in the 108px surface.
Before I re-enable Floating, I see the dock use a 100px-high surface with no room below the panel.
Before I re-enable Floating, I see the flush panel start at y=36.
Before I re-enable Floating, I see the 64px panel end exactly at the 100px surface edge.
After I re-enable Floating, I see the dock surface grow back to 108px.
After I re-enable Floating, I see the panel at y=36 again.
After I re-enable Floating, I see the 64px panel end at y=100 and restore the 8px gap below it.
